# Quest Encyclopedia

## Quest Types

### By Duration

| Type | Time | Difficulty | Reward |
|------|------|------------|--------|
| Hour | 1-4 hours | Easy | 50-100 xp |
| Session | 4-8 hours | Medium | 100-300 xp |
| Multi | Several sessions | Hard | 500+ xp |
| Campaign | Multiple sessions | Epic | Legendary |

### By Scope

| Type | Scope | Example |
|------|-------|----------|
| Personal | Single PC | Revenge |
| Local | Village/city | Save town |
| Regional | Multiple towns | Stop war |
| World | Entire realm | Save kingdom |
| Plane | Multiple planes | Stop apocalypse |

### By Genre

| Type | Description | Examples |
|------|-------------|----------|
| Combat | Defeat enemies | Hunt monster |
| Exploration | Discover | Find location |
| Social | Negotiate | Diplomatic |
| Mystery | Solve | Investigate |
| Crafting | Create | Enchant |
| Survival | Endure | Survive |

## Quest Structure

### Hook (Why)

- Requested by NPC
- Discovered clue
- Needed item
- Rumor in town
- Wanted poster
- Guild quest

### Objective (What)

- Defeat specific enemy
- Find item/person
- Protect target
- Discover truth
- Deliver package
- Solve puzzle
- Negotiate deal

### Complication (How)

| Type | Effect |
|------|--------|
| Rival faction | Competing quest |
| Time limit | Must complete |
| Restricted resources | Limited access |
| Secret identity | Cannot reveal |
| Moral choice | Grey decision |
| Unknown enemy | Hidden threat |

### Resolution (Who)

- Return to quest giver
- Public announcement
- Use found information
- Complete ritual
- Defeat in combat
- Discover truth

## Quest Templates

### Rescue Mission

1. NPC captured by enemy
2. Gather intelligence
3. Infiltrate location
4. Neutralize guards
5. Extract target
6. Escape pursuit

### Monster Hunt

1. Monster terrorizing area
2. Track to lair
3. Research weaknesses
4. Prepare gear
5. Confront in lair
6. Claim trophy

### Escort Quest

1. Meet protected NPC
2. Journey dangerous route
3. Face hazards
4. Arrive safely
5. Payment

### Investigation

1. Incident occurs
2. Gather clues
3. Interview suspects
4. Follow leads
5. Discover truth
6. Resolution

### Delivery

1. Receive package
2. Travel to destination
3. Complications
4. Deliver intact
5. Payment

### Treasure Hunt

1. Discover map/rumor
2. Research location
3. Travel to site
4. Clear obstacles
5. Claim treasure
6. Escape trap
